function.name: hospital_locate
function.description: Locate nearby hospitals based on location and radius. Options to include specific departments are available.

location.description: The city and state, e.g. Denver, CO

radius.description: The radius within which you want to find the hospital in kms.

department.description: Specific department within the hospital. Default is 'General Medicine'.
